guitar.guitaristsText: Paul McCartney / Denny Laine / Henry McCullough
guitar.evidence: Paul McCartney is most famous for his Höfner 500/1 violin bass (well documented from Beatles era onward), and Wings guitarists Denny Laine/Henry McCullough used Gibson-style guitars; reasonably documented.
guitar.notes: Filled from unknown; McCartney's Höfner bass is iconic though he is primarily a bassist, not lead guitarist.

tone.target: theatrical clean-to-crunch stadium rock with orchestral drive and bright edge
tone.profile: theatrical clean-to-crunch stadium rock with orchestral drive and bright edge
tone.summary: A bright, dynamic signal chain starting with light compression and an OD boost for bite. The core tone uses the UK 45 amp model paired with the UK Vintage 4x12 cab, providing a classic British crunch foundation. Chorus is applied selectively for lead sheen, complemented by Tape delay and Room reverb to achieve the theatrical, expansive sound.
corrections: make chorus optional on lead only
